facts.fact: ANSUT, the universal telecommunications service agency, says its National Broadband Network (RNHD) has 5,207 km of fibre laid and is boosting 3G and 4G rollout in rural areas and the interior.

CIV.note: Counts kilometres of fibre, not rural sites or people connected.

facts.fact: ANSUT says it builds digital infrastructure within the Strategie Nationale de Developpement du Numerique 2021-2025.
facts.system: Strategie Nationale de Developpement du Numerique 2021-2025

CIV.note: No budget, fund or spending figures stated.
Mentions network connection of prefectures for eGOUV programmes, not services people complete online.
